en.title: Maximum Strength Sum After Adjacent Swaps
en.description:
You are given an array of positive integers. You may choose several pairwise non-adjacent index pairs (i,i+1) and swap their elements, or make no swaps at all. Each element takes part in at most one swap. Indices start at 0, and after the swaps the strength of the array is Σ arr[i]×(i+1). Find the maximum strength.



This site added a standard input/output protocol; this does not mean the original site's function-style problem had this protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000), and the second line contains n integers arr[i] (1 ≤ arr[i] ≤ 100000).
en.output: Output the maximum achievable strength sum.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for the rules, approach, and proof.
hints: Use the contribution without any swaps as the baseline. Swapping i and i+1 gains arr[i]−arr[i+1]; use a linear DP to take the better of making an adjacent swap or skipping.
